fit_reason: Private owner selling a complete aluminum fishing boat package (Lund S-14 with motor and trailer) in the boats by owner section.
findings: Bare aluminum lower hull on both sides and the bow looks dull and hazy with uneven gray patches rather than a bright finish
Blue painted upper hull sides look somewhat flat with light scuffs near the bow
Light dirt, debris and water marks on the turquoise interior floor and seat sides
Dark bench seat tops show scattered light spots and dust
Aluminum gunwale rails look dull and weathered
message: Hi, we saw your listing for the Lund S-14 package. It looks well kept, but the bare aluminum lower hull and gunwales look a bit dull and hazy in the photos, and the interior floor has some dirt and water marks. We do pre-sale cleanups for boats and come to you, including a wash, polish of the aluminum and paint, and an interior wipe-down. Would you like a quote?
